consequence.label: every PASS and NOT_SUSTAINED point of the family is NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED (its raw values are reported with that label)
consequence.classification: a NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED point is an unknown, like NUMERICAL_FAILURE: it never counts toward feasibility (never CLOSES) and never toward an evaluated non-closure; every Hall test of the family is NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with blocker NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED, A9.31 sec. 21 category MISSING_EVIDENCE
